description: This file defines the DynamicMCPSkillManager class responsible for discovering, registering, and managing MCP (Multi-Client Protocol) tools as skills within an AgentField environment. It handles MCP server discovery, health checks, tool listing, dynamic creation of Pydantic schemas, FastAPI endpoint registration, and skill metadata management.

classes.name: DynamicMCPSkillManager
classes.description: Manages discovery and registration of MCP tools as skills, converting them into FastAPI endpoints with appropriate input validation schemas.

methods.name: __init__(self, agent, dev_mode: bool = False)
methods.description: Initializes the skill manager with the agent reference and optional dev mode flag.

methods.name: None discover_and_register_all_skills(self)
methods.description: Discovers all MCP tools from registered MCP servers, performs health checks, and registers each as a corresponding AgentField skill with schema and endpoint.

methods.name: None _register_mcp_tool_as_skill( self, server_alias: str, tool: Dict[str, Any], skill_name: str )
methods.description: Registers a specific MCP tool as an AgentField skill, creating input schemas, endpoints, and metadata.

methods.name: Type[BaseModel] _create_input_schema_from_tool( self, skill_name: str, tool: Dict[str, Any] )
methods.description: Generates a Pydantic validation schema based on the MCP tool's inputSchema definition.

ctags.name: _create_input_schema_from_tool
ctags.signature: ( self, skill_name: str, tool: Dict[str, Any] )

ctags.name: _register_mcp_tool_as_skill
ctags.signature: ( self, server_alias: str, tool: Dict[str, Any], skill_name: str )

ctags.name: mcp_skill_endpoint
ctags.pattern: /^        async def mcp_skill_endpoint(input_data: Any, request: Request):$/
